fragments.text: the MREL is not a fixed figure.
Instead, it must be set by resolution authorities on a case-by-case basis for each institution to ensure it is sufficient to implement their resolution plans.

fragments.section_anchor: FSB issues final Total Loss-Absorbing Capacity standard for global systemically important banks
fragments.text: The Financial Stability Board (FSB) today issued the final Total Loss-Absorbing Capacity (TLAC) standard for global systemically important banks (G-SIBs).

fragments.section_anchor: FSB issues final Total Loss-Absorbing Capacity standard for global systemically important banks
fragments.text: G-SIBs will be required to meet the TLAC requirement alongside the minimum regulatory requirements set out in the Basel III framework.
